one_line_summary: {[Zn(ATz)(Pyc)]-0.5DMF}n shows air_stability = 0.0 dimensionless for target gas

key_insights.title: Mechanism
key_insights.body: SO4^2- participates in framework formation with ATz → stability

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] include HPyc in the synthesis of compound 1 → HPyc is important for obtaining high-quality single crystals of compound 1

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] change the inorganic anion by using a different zinc salt under otherwise similar reaction conditions → the final framework structure changes significantly because different anions direct different assemblies

key_insights.title: Failure
key_insights.body: [performance_regression] omit HPyc from the ZnSO4 + HATz solvothermal synthesis in DMF: the reaction produced a very air-unstable small polycrystalline sample rather than the pure phase of compound 1

notable_quotes: Using HATz/HPyc in DMF with ZnSO4 or Zn(NO3)2 gave two distinct Zn(II) coordination polymers, 1 and 2, in high yields of 92% and 87%, respectively.
Anion coordination strength controls framework assembly: SO4^2- enters compound 1's framework, while weaker NO3^- does not participate in compound 2.
Without HPyc, ZnSO4 and HATz produce an air-unstable small polycrystalline sample that PXRD shows is not the pure phase of compound 1.
